doc: P2.01 meter arithmetic. Sources: docs/01_GAME_DESIGN.md §2 (instability ratchet floor = peak - 15; per-turn slow burn +0.35 +0.15*(Fixation/100) -0.2*(Lucidity/100); per day +3; model suggestion caps) and docs/02_DIRECTOR_PROTOCOL.md §1.1 (mood ints -3..3, scaled affection x1.5, trust x2, stress -> instability x0.6). These numbers ARE the design formula: changing one requires a DCR and the doc-value test in tests/test_meters.py, never a quiet tweak. Read by game/llm/Meters.gd; the in-code fallback there holds the same values so a broken file degrades to the documented formula.
